module: Bridge between the native Windows console window (C++) and Lua. It fills the dropdown list of execution contexts (GE-Lua, current vehicle, each active vehicle, GE-TorqueScript, CEF/UI - JS) and executes the typed command in the chosen context. Everything is called by the engine; a modder can only listen to the onConsoleExecuteCommand hook.
notes: If the C++ functions consoleClearAvailableContexts etc. do not exist (other platform), onExtensionLoaded returns false and the extension stays inactive (refreshCombo does nothing).
The 'GE-Lua' context is not handled in executeCommand: it is executed on the C++ side (tryRunCommand is the callback used).
Vehicle contexts are named after mainPartName; two vehicles of the same model share the same name, so nameVidMap only keeps one.

configure.desc: Rebuilds the list of contexts available in the console (alias of refreshCombo). Called by C++ when the console window is activated.

executeCommand.desc: Executes a command in a context and emits the onConsoleExecuteCommand(context, cmd) hook. 'GE-TorqueScript' goes through TorqueScript.eval, 'CEF/UI - JS' through be:queueJS, a vehicle name through queueLuaCommand on that vehicle.

context.desc: Name of the context chosen in the console.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: enables the extension if the C++ console functions exist.

returns.desc: false if the console is not available on the platform.

onVehicleActiveChanged.desc: Hook called when a vehicle becomes active or inactive: refreshes the context list (same function as configure).

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is destroyed: refreshes the context list.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook called when a vehicle spawns: refreshes the context list.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when the player vehicle changes: refreshes the context list.

tryRunCommand.desc: Executes Lua text in the GE VM: tries loadstring(cmd), otherwise loadstring('return ' .. cmd) to display the value of an expression, then dumps the result if it is not nil. Logs "syntax error" if nothing compiles.
